items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Happy Johnson's Big Band for a while.

ctx.x: Oh, I worked with Happy Johnson's Big Band for a while. Different ones off a -- Central Avenue would come up with a gig occassionally. Like the drummers especially, they loved to play with me, you know. After I'd been back - East and been exposed and what not, you know. They all loved me. John Simmons, is back in town, John's back in town, you know. So naturally, I got a plenty gigs. I didn't have to look for any gigs, they could come to me, they came to me.

I'd go on them for fun, you know. Renewing old acquaintances, old lang syne, (laughter). Or this was the year that King Cole started singing. '47. He lived in a house on Avalon just across the street. Like I lived on 47th Street behind the funeral home and he lived on Avalon across the street from the funeral home. And I went over there, and offered him some grass. And it was like the most highly insult he ever received in his life. I say well what is wrong and he say, well I am singing now, John, I had to stop…
